import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import warnings
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import lightgbm as lgb
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
np.random.seed(42)


def main():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("NYC Taxi Fare Prediction (Normalized Coordinates)")
    print("=" * 60)

    print("\n1. Loading data...")
    train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
    sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

    print(f"   Training: {len(train_df):,} | Test: {len(test_df):,}")

    print("\n2. Parsing datetime (vectorized)...")
    train_df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(
        train_df["pickup_datetime"], errors="coerce"
    )
    test_df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(
        test_df["pickup_datetime"], errors="coerce"
    )

    print("\n3. Extracting time features...")
    for df in [train_df, test_df]:
        dt = df["pickup_datetime"].copy()
        df["hour"] = dt.dt.hour
        df["minute"] = dt.dt.minute
        df["day"] = dt.dt.day
        df["weekday"] = dt.dt.dayofweek
        df["month"] = dt.dt.month
        df["dayofyear"] = dt.dt.dayofyear
        df["is_weekend"] = (df["weekday"] >= 5).astype(int)

    print("\n4. Handling missing coordinates...")
    # Normalize coordinates by their own range per dataset
    for name, data in [("train", train_df), ("test", test_df)]:
        lat_min = data["pickup_latitude"].min()
        lat_max = data["pickup_latitude"].max()
        lon_min = data["pickup_longitude"].min()
        lon_max = data["pickup_longitude"].max()

        # Normalize to 0-1 range
        data["pickup_lat_norm"] = (data["pickup_latitude"] - lat_min) / (
            lat_max - lat_min + 1e-8
        )
        data["pickup_lon_norm"] = (data["pickup_longitude"] - lon_min) / (
            lon_max - lon_min + 1e-8
        )
        data["dropoff_lat_norm"] = (data["dropoff_latitude"] - lat_min) / (
            lat_max - lat_min + 1e-8
        )
        data["dropoff_lon_norm"] = (data["dropoff_longitude"] - lon_min) / (
            lon_max - lon_min + 1e-8
        )

        # Fill NaNs in coordinates with median
        for col in [
            "pickup_latitude",
            "pickup_longitude",
            "dropoff_latitude",
            "dropoff_longitude",
        ]:
            data[col] = data[col].fillna(data[col].median())

    print("\n5. Calculating normalized distance features...")

    def calc_normalized_distance(df):
        lat_diff = df["dropoff_lat_norm"] - df["pickup_lat_norm"]
        lon_diff = df["dropoff_lon_norm"] - df["pickup_lon_norm"]
        return np.sqrt(lat_diff**2 + lon_diff**2)

    train_df["distance_norm"] = calc_normalized_distance(train_df)
    test_df["distance_norm"] = calc_normalized_distance(test_df)
    train_df["passenger_count"] = train_df["passenger_count"].fillna(1)
    test_df["passenger_count"] = test_df["passenger_count"].fillna(1)

    print("\n6. Creating feature matrix...")
    feature_cols = [
        "hour",
        "minute",
        "day",
        "dayofyear",
        "weekday",
        "month",
        "is_weekend",
        "pickup_lat_norm",
        "pickup_lon_norm",
        "dropoff_lat_norm",
        "dropoff_lon_norm",
        "distance_norm",
        "passenger_count",
    ]

    X_train_full = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
    y_train_full = train_df["fare_amount"].copy()
    X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

    # Handle remaining NaNs
    for col in feature_cols:
        med = X_train_full[col].median()
        X_train_full[col] = X_train_full[col].fillna(med)
        X_test[col] = X_test[col].fillna(med)

    print("\n7. Creating validation split (20% holdout, stratified by distance)...")
    n = len(X_train_full)
    n_val = int(0.2 * n)
    indices = np.arange(n)

    # Stratified split by distance quantiles
    train_df["dist_q"] = pd.qcut(
        train_df["distance_norm"], q=10, labels=False, duplicates="drop"
    )
    val_indices = np.random.choice(indices, size=n_val, replace=False)
    val_idx_set = set(val_indices)

    X_val = X_train_full.loc[val_indices]
    y_val = y_train_full.loc[val_indices]
    X_train = X_train_full.drop(val_indices)
    y_train = y_train_full.drop(val_indices)

    print(f"   Train: {len(X_train):,} | Val: {len(X_val):,}")

    print("\n8. Training LightGBM model...")
    lgb_params = {
        "objective": "regression",
        "metric": "rmse",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 5,
        "verbose": -1,
        "n_jobs": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "deterministic_feature_fraction": False,
    }

    train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train, feature_name=feature_cols)
    val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

    callbacks = [
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100, verbose=False),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=50),
    ]

    model = lgb.train(
        lgb_params,
        train_data,
        num_boost_round=300,
        valid_sets=[val_data],
        callbacks=callbacks,
    )

    print("\n9. Generating predictions...")
    y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
    y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

    print("\n10. Calculating validation RMSE...")
    val_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, y_val_pred))
    print(f"   Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.6f}")

    print("\n11. Saving submission...")
    os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
    submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"key": test_df["key"], "fare_amount": y_test_pred})
    submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print("   Saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print(f"FINAL VALIDATION RMSE: {val_rmse:.6f}")
    print("=" * 60)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
